about.title: A bit about me
paragraphs: Frontend engineer with three years of commercial experience. I work on complex, data-heavy SPAs: real-time interfaces, interactive maps and visualization of large datasets.
I own a feature from implementation through production: architecture, performance and production issues. I do code review, mentor, and maintain CI/CD.
My main stack is Vue 3 and TypeScript. I also work with React and Next.js.

highlights: Own complex frontend features from implementation through production.
Build real-time monitoring interfaces with REST APIs and WebSockets.
Develop interactive maps with OpenLayers and deck.gl for large point sets.
Led frontend architecture and UI decisions during a redesign.
Profile and optimize the SPA, and investigate production issues.
Review code and help the team with frontend decisions.
Maintain CI/CD across development, staging and production.
Landing pages, SPAs and CRM systems.
